scope: Official documentation/source research, not live host validation. Paths are deployment paths relative to the target project unless explicitly user/profile scoped.

harnesses.name: Devin
harnesses.identity: Cognition Devin CLI local harness; not a claim of equivalent Devin Cloud configuration
harnesses.instructions: Project root AGENTS.md, automatically read unless importing standard rules is disabled by host configuration.
harnesses.skills: .devin/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; name/description YAML plus Markdown. Compatible .agents/skills and .windsurf/skills are also documented; this payload uses native .devin only.
harnesses.agents: .devin/agents/<name>.md with name/description and allowed-tools: []; full existing mathematical role prompt. Directory AGENT.md layout and .agents/agents are supported alternatives but not duplicated.
harnesses.delegation: Native run_subagent selects the registered profile; read_subagent retrieves results. Use the live tool schema with the complete exact packet. Foreground/background workers have separate conversation chains; no parent chat history, but codebase context can be shared.
harnesses.limits: Custom agents are experimental. Omitted model uses the host default subagent model, router/admin-selected, not the parent model. Parent-effort inheritance is not confirmed. MathTrace supplies no model pin/router or nesting override; incompatible delegation stays blocked pending manual user configuration. Empty tool allowlist requests no tools but effective enforcement is unvalidated. No capture backend. Shared role bodies are now byte-identical; compatibility must be established by root before dispatch so the inherited-model sentence is applicable, never rewritten to mask the mismatch.
harnesses.install: See SETUP.md. Merge .devin/skills and .devin/agents into the target project; keep shared files and existing AGENTS.md. Install/authenticate the official Devin CLI separately. Do not hand off to Cloud or enable Fusion/Adaptive routing as part of this adapter. No installation or host configuration change is performed here.

harnesses.name: Muse Code
harnesses.identity: Meta Muse Code; official dev.meta.ai manual and Meta Models developer documentation (next channel)
harnesses.instructions: Project AGENTS.md in a trusted workspace; native loading order checks AGENTS.md before CLAUDE.md, .agents/AGENTS.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md at each directory level.
harnesses.skills: .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; YAML name/description plus Markdown; /<name> or native read_skill activation. Project skills require workspace trust.
harnesses.agents: Native dynamic subagents confirmed; complete standalone custom-agent schema/location not confirmed in inspected sources. Plugin docs mention reviewed Markdown agents under agents/ but do not establish a deployable project schema. Use shared role prompts through the native dynamic tool; no invented .muse/agents schema.
harnesses.delegation: Root supplies the selected shared role body and complete exact packet to the installed native subagent tools using their actual schema. Workers share checkout by default; per-child worktree isolation is optional and not read isolation. Children can spawn descendants, which MathTrace's role policy prohibits.
harnesses.limits: Dynamic tool parameter names, per-child tool denial, complete custom-agent schema and exact model/effort inheritance remain unconfirmed in the inspected official pages. Do not infer them from Codex or Claude formats. No plugin agent capability declaration is fabricated; the docs distinguish advanced reviewed agent files from unsupported capabilities.agents entries. No capture backend or automatic model/effort override. Compatibility imports can install Claude-style agent declarations while leaving them inactive; reviewed plugin agent paths do not establish a general project schema. Worktree separation does not prove input blindness.
harnesses.install: See SETUP.md. Merge only .agents/skills into the target project's skill directory, resolving existing names without replacing a managed .agents tree. Keep shared role library available and merge existing AGENTS instructions once. Trust the workspace through normal host setup. No plugin installation, settings changes or host launch occurs here.

harnesses.name: Command Code
harnesses.identity: CommandCodeAI/command-code and commandcode.ai; distinct product with its own native agent registry, not Claude Code or the Pi provider
harnesses.instructions: Root AGENTS.md; .commandcode/AGENTS.md is the documented alternative, used only if root AGENTS.md is absent. Merge shared project instructions once; no CLAUDE.md.
harnesses.skills: .commandcode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (this payload); .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md also discovered. Native project skills take precedence on name conflicts; /<name> or /skill:<name>.
harnesses.agents: .commandcode/agents/<name>.md: YAML name/description, full role body as system prompt. Omitted tools means none; model and reasoningEffort are omitted. Eleven roles supplied.
harnesses.delegation: Native agent tool with description, subagent_type: selected math-* name, and prompt: complete exact packet. Multiple calls can run in parallel; background output uses agent_id with agent_output. Children cannot delegate.
harnesses.limits: Documented model inheritance follows the active conversation model, including any host planning/implementation model. Omitted reasoningEffort uses the model default, not documented session-effort inheritance: exact parent-effort preservation is therefore unsupported by this adapter. No automatic compensation/override is added. Personal agents load before project agents and first name wins. Host bootstrap/context/tool behavior is not live-validated; no producer-bound capture backend. Required exact-effort dispatch remains unavailable unless installed-host evidence or explicit manual configuration establishes equality; no reasoningEffort: inherit field is invented.
harnesses.install: See SETUP.md. Install/authenticate Command Code through its official quickstart (Node.js 22+); merge only .commandcode/skills and .commandcode/agents into the project. Keep shared project paths intact. No Pi extension or Claude configuration is required or copied. Inspect effective agent definitions for personal-name collisions and disclose the documented effort mismatch before delegation. This task installs or launches nothing.

harnesses.name: Antigravity
harnesses.identity: Google Antigravity CLI; existing ready project build
harnesses.instructions: AGENTS.md or GEMINI.md; this payload preserves the existing .agents projection only, without restoring the paused root instruction files.
harnesses.delegation: invoke_subagent using the existing root-mediated reserve/inspect/admit/capture/recover protocol.
harnesses.limits: Byte-preserved copy of the ready build. Existing runtime and recorded-input qualification prerequisites still apply; residual platform controls remain callable. No new host run.
harnesses.install: The .agents directory is copied, not moved. Root installation remains authoritative and untouched. Do not invoke the managed installer against this staging directory. For a separate project use the existing supported installation procedure; merge shared project instructions deliberately. The copy's internal paths assume deployment as project-root .agents and the normal runtime/docs layout.

harnesses.name: Codex
harnesses.identity: OpenAI Codex, current documented custom-agent format
harnesses.instructions: Project AGENTS.md; preserve existing shared instructions and merge the supplied snippet.
harnesses.skills: Existing .codex/skills/<name>/SKILL.md wrappers and .agents/skills compatibility wrappers; deploy the location appropriate to the installed host without duplication.
harnesses.agents: .codex/agents/<name>.toml with name, description, developer_instructions paired with companion .codex/agents/<name>.md
harnesses.delegation: Native subagent spawning to the selected custom agent, using the currently exposed spawn_agent schema and complete exact packet.
harnesses.limits: Child sandbox, approvals, MCP and provider settings inherit host policy. Agent files do not establish per-child tool denial; tool-free remains a prompt policy. Model and reasoning fields are omitted. No non-Antigravity capture backend.
harnesses.install: Preserve the existing .codex/skills and .codex/agents structure; .agents/skills is a maintained compatibility payload. Deploy one appropriate wrapper location; do not replace the existing Antigravity .agents directory or its manifest. Name collisions require choosing one active skill wrapper per name. Custom agents are supplied as standalone TOML configurations paired with companion role Markdown files (.codex/agents/*.md).

harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.identity: Anthropic Claude Code with direct AGENTS.md support
harnesses.instructions: Shared project AGENTS.md directly. Requires v2.1.277+; use a current version (v2.1.285+ for the bundled plugin ID in launch-settings.json). No CLAUDE.md is created.
harnesses.agents: .claude/agents/<name>.md; name/description, tools: [], model: inherit, omitClaudeMd: true
harnesses.delegation: Agent tool with the selected math-* subagent_type and exact packet; use a fresh non-fork worker.
harnesses.limits: omitClaudeMd omits user/project/local instructions, including loaded AGENTS.md; managed policy can remain. Environment/git metadata and effective tools still require inspection. No capture backend for this host. model: inherit is supported and intentionally retained; removing it can expose environment defaults. Deliberately empty tool lists are allowed. Invocation/environment/mod overrides can affect model and effort; omit effort to preserve session behavior and inspect effective settings.
harnesses.install: Merge .claude/skills and .claude/agents. Merge the MathTrace snippet into the project's existing AGENTS.md. Default claude-md-or-agents-md loads AGENTS only if cwd/ancestors lack CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md. Optional: launch with claude --settings coding-harnesses/claude-code/launch-settings.json to select claude-md-and-agents-md. The other documented modes are claude-md and managed-only; neither is this adapter's loading choice. Configure via /config, user/managed settings or --settings: project/local settings ignore this pluginConfigs option. Before v2.1.285 the plugin ID is agents-md@builtin. Before v2.1.281 some Bedrock/telemetry-off sessions lack support; disabled plugin or first post-upgrade session can also prevent loading. Update/enable/restart and confirm loading; do not add a redirect CLAUDE.md as a workaround.

harnesses.name: Grok Build
harnesses.instructions: Project AGENTS.md; startup rule loading requires folder trust.
harnesses.skills: .grok/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; skill slash commands (legacy commands are unnecessary)
harnesses.delegation: spawn_subagent selecting the discovered custom subagent_type, with the exact packet in its prompt.
harnesses.limits: agentsMd: false suppresses project instruction discovery for workers; tools: [] requests no tools. Effective MCP/context and producer attribution are unvalidated here. No model/effort overrides or capture backend. Spawn, role and persona defaults precede parent model/effort fallback. Connected MCP servers inherit by default; inspect effective filtering. Do not substitute cheaper built-ins or resume history for blind tasks.
harnesses.install: Merge .grok/skills and .grok/agents; merge the shared AGENTS snippet. Use this product's camelCase agent fields, not another harness's YAML schema.

harnesses.name: Cursor
harnesses.identity: Cursor Agent with documented skills and custom subagents
harnesses.instructions: Project AGENTS.md; no duplicated .cursor/rules policy is needed.
harnesses.agents: .cursor/agents/<name>.md; name, description, model: inherit, readonly: true
harnesses.delegation: Native Task delegation to the selected math-* agent with the exact packet.
harnesses.limits: readonly is weaker than tool-free and does not prove blind context or denial of shell/read access. No documented no-tools field is invented; prompt policy remains essential. No capture backend. model: inherit is documented and retained. Legacy request-based plans without Max can substitute Composer; admin/availability limits can also change the effective model. Exact effort parameter inheritance requires observation.
harnesses.install: Merge .cursor/skills and .cursor/agents and the shared AGENTS snippet. Keep readonly on worker definitions; root retains normal mediation duties.

harnesses.name: OpenCode V1
harnesses.identity: OpenCode V1 Markdown-agent profile with singular permission; use opencode-v2 for the incompatible V2 dialect
harnesses.agents: .opencode/agents/<name>.md; description, mode: subagent, permission wildcard deny
harnesses.delegation: Task delegation or @math-* selection with the exact packet; explicit user selection alone is not evidence capture.
harnesses.limits: Permission denial is configured, not live-verified; ambient instructions/context still need inspection. Native commands exist in .opencode/commands, but no duplicate command set is added. No capture backend.
harnesses.install: See SETUP.md. Merge only this V1 .opencode/skills and .opencode/agents into the project, preserving configuration and shared AGENTS instructions. Do not merge opencode-v2 into the same discovery directory. Verify the installed generation before dispatch.

harnesses.name: OpenCode V2
harnesses.identity: OpenCode V2 Markdown-agent profile with plural ordered permissions; explicitly separate from V1 and Kilo
harnesses.agents: .opencode/agents/<name>.md; filename-derived ID, description, mode: subagent, permissions: [{action: "*", resource: "*", effect: deny}].
harnesses.delegation: Native V2 subagent delegation or direct named agent selection using the installed schema and complete exact packet. User selection alone is not evidence capture.
harnesses.limits: V2 uses permissions, shell and subagent instead of V1 permission, bash and task. Catch-all action/resource denial is configured, not live-verified. Effective model/effort and ambient context still require inspection; no pins or automatic routing are added. No capture backend.
harnesses.install: See SETUP.md. Merge only this V2 .opencode/skills and .opencode/agents into the project, preserving existing configuration and shared AGENTS instructions. Do not deploy the opencode V1 payload alongside this same-name role set. Verify the installed generation and effective permission rules.

harnesses.name: Pi
harnesses.identity: earendil-works/pi coding agent with its official examples/extensions/subagent extension explicitly installed; not a built-in core feature
harnesses.agents: Official extension's .pi/agents/<name>.md: YAML name and description, full role prompt as body; eleven specialist definitions. Model/thinking overrides omitted.
harnesses.delegation: Extension subagent tool: single agent/task, parallel tasks, or chain; agentScope: project enables project definitions, both combines them with user agents. Default user scope excludes project agents. Each invocation launches a separate Pi process; omitted model inherits the dispatching model and thinking level.
harnesses.limits: Extension required. Empty tools lists become undefined and do not request zero tools; tool-free remains the role policy. Processes retain host bootstrap/project resources and effective tools: separate process is not proven read/context isolation. Parallel output can be truncated; chain previous-output substitution is unsuitable for blind work. No producer-bound capture backend or new workflow presets.
harnesses.install: Follow SETUP.md to install/link the official index.ts and agents.ts together from a compatible Pi checkout into the user extension directory. Merge .pi/skills and .pi/agents into the target project and the shared AGENTS snippet once. Pass agentScope: project on MathTrace subagent calls; retain project-agent confirmation. No extension is installed or launched by this packaging task. FALLBACK.md is a superseded pointer, not the active integration.

harnesses.name: OMP
harnesses.identity: Oh My Pi: can1357/oh-my-pi. The abbreviation is ambiguous; this payload targets this official repository, not other forks/products.
harnesses.instructions: Project AGENTS.md via agents-md context provider; native .omp/AGENTS.md is also supported but not duplicated here.
harnesses.delegation: task tool with tasks:[{agent: selected math-* name, task: complete exact packet prompt, solutionSpace: task scope}] and only task-neutral common context.
harnesses.limits: tools: [] disables built-ins, but MCP/extensions/custom tools remain additive and required yield may remain. spawns: [] disables declared child spawning. Host model-role/default configuration can affect selection; no model or effort field is added. No capture backend. Plan mode replaces worker tools with read-oriented capabilities; structured mode can add yield. Neither is zero-tool operation. Omitted thinking alone does not establish equality with the live parent effort; inspect settings and effective resolved controls.
harnesses.install: Merge .omp/skills and .omp/agents, plus the shared AGENTS snippet. Inspect effective providers/additive tools and selected model settings; do not treat an empty built-in list as enforced universal tool denial.

harnesses.name: PrimeAgent
harnesses.identity: PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent; current Rust implementation, not stale Pi-derived layouts or unrelated similarly named products
harnesses.instructions: Project AGENTS.md, confirmed in resource discovery source
harnesses.agents: No static custom-agent filesystem format confirmed in the inspected current source; shared role prompts provided instead.
harnesses.delegation: Documented rlm.spawn(...) creates dynamic children via the Python REPL. Root supplies the exact role and packet through the live exposed schema; no guessed arguments or .prime/agents definitions.
harnesses.limits: The audited Rust child host inherits parent model identity and thinking when no override is requested. Effective tools/context and producer-bound admission remain unvalidated; spawn returns an admission handle before completion. Older TypeScript package guides do not describe this tree. No capture backend.
harnesses.install: Merge .prime/agent/skills and shared AGENTS snippet; use FALLBACK.md for dynamic role binding or labeled inline exploration when delegation is unavailable.

harnesses.name: Cline CLI
harnesses.identity: Cline CLI configured-agent loader at the audited source revision; verify the installed release
harnesses.instructions: Project AGENTS.md is supported; .clinerules/mathtrace.md is an additional supplied root rule wrapper. Merge shared instructions once.
harnesses.agents: .cline/agents/<name>.yaml: YAML frontmatter plus full Markdown role body; name, description and tools: []. The audited scanner accepts .yaml/.yml, not .md.
harnesses.delegation: Native named tools such as subagent_math_referee with prompt containing the complete exact exported packet. Profile supplies the unchanged role body; use actual exposed schema. Generic spawn_agent is only a broader compatibility fallback.
harnesses.limits: Worker skills, providerId and modelId are omitted. Declaring skills, even [], adds a skills tool. Empty tools remain empty in the audited runtime filter; base runtime model and thinking/effort are inherited. Verify installed-version discovery and effective context/tools/settings before dispatch. Generic Plan/Act subagents have broader tools; prompt restrictions and capture gates remain mandatory. No capture backend.
harnesses.install: See SETUP.md. Merge .cline/agents and .cline/skills into the target root, preserving external files. Merge shared AGENTS instructions once; retain the supplied .clinerules wrapper as needed. Confirm the installed loader contract before activation; GSD Markdown output does not establish scanner compatibility.

harnesses.name: Kilo
harnesses.identity: Current Kilo CLI/custom-subagent documentation; not legacy extension .kilocodemodes
harnesses.agents: .kilo/agents/<name>.md (plural agents); description, mode: subagent, permission denials
harnesses.delegation: Native Task delegation or @math-* selection with the complete exact packet.
harnesses.limits: No pinned model or provider reasoning fields; documented default uses invoking primary model. A documented top-level wildcard denies tool permissions; effective extension/MCP tools and context remain unvalidated. No capture backend.
harnesses.install: Merge .kilo/skills and .kilo/agents, plus shared AGENTS snippet. No legacy .kilocodemodes or neighboring OpenCode configuration is copied.

harnesses.name: Kimi Code
harnesses.identity: MoonshotAI/kimi-code current Node CLI Markdown profiles; archived Python kimi-cli is retired from this adapter
harnesses.instructions: Project AGENTS.md; preserve existing instructions and generic .agents assets.
harnesses.agents: .kimi-code/agents/<name>.md with name, description, tools: [], subagents: [] and the unchanged full role body. No legacy YAML agent map or provider model fields.
harnesses.delegation: Native Agent tool selecting a discovered math-* subagent_type with the complete exact task packet. Use a fresh context and the installed tool schema.
harnesses.limits: Without a secondary-model pool/force override, model and thinking inherit. A configured secondary pool changes omission semantics; verify effective settings and do not enable routing. Empty tools/subagents are explicit denials. Project-root discovery and effective context/tool controls require installed-version inspection; unknown foreign model/mode fields are not inheritance controls. No capture backend.
harnesses.install: See SETUP.md. Merge only .kimi-code/skills and .kimi-code/agents into the target project; keep shared references and existing AGENTS instructions. Start a fresh host session and confirm project-root discovery, especially outside a Git checkout. Extra roots use extra_agent_dirs. Installed legacy configuration and external/modified files are preserved.

harnesses.name: DSH
harnesses.identity: DeepSeek Harness: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness (developer preview); abbreviation also names unrelated shells/distributions
harnesses.instructions: Project AGENTS.md via agent-instructions plugin in dsh-base; profiles may change plugin availability.
harnesses.agents: No universal static role-agent file format confirmed; subagent providers and agentPreset are profile/plugin composition.
harnesses.delegation: Native subagent tool configured for the documented spawn provider (subagent-spawn-in-process) with the complete role/packet. Fresh spawn inherits provider/model/effort by default; fork seeds history and is unsuitable for blind tasks. Use actual exposed schema.
harnesses.limits: Requires the instruction/skill/subagent plugins and an inspected provider/preset composition. The preset registry does not scan role directories. Spawn inherits provider/model/reasoning unless agentOptions override them; parent agent-local tool restrictions are not imported automatically. No zero-tool preset bundle or capture backend is supplied.
harnesses.install: Merge .dsh/skills and shared AGENTS snippet. Use FALLBACK.md. This targets the official master branch; a missing main-branch document is not evidence of absent support.

harnesses.name: Hermes Agent
harnesses.skills: Default ~/.hermes/skills; this payload uses opt-in skills.external_dirs pointing to coding-harnesses/hermes-agent/skills
harnesses.agents: No static custom-agent filesystem format confirmed; dynamic role prompts provided.
harnesses.delegation: delegate_task with exact role/packet in its documented goal/context inputs. Children inherit parent toolsets; do not invent a toolsets argument.
harnesses.limits: Default leaf children inherit parent model/reasoning absent delegation overrides, plus enabled tools and workspace instruction context. Opt-in orchestrators can delegate further when depth allows; MathTrace does not enable this. No model-facing toolsets parameter or static agent discovery is established. GSD-generated agents are not loader evidence. Optional output-schema tolerance does not replace the exact unfenced JSON contract. No capture backend.
harnesses.install: Keep skills here. Merge config.example.yaml into a chosen Hermes profile/user config after setting MATHTRACE_WORKSPACE to an absolute project path; do not copy it as an automatically loaded project config. Alternatively deliberately install the skills under that profile's skills directory. Shared references require the target project as working directory. No home/profile config is modified by this task.
